_comment: Word-division join rule for the Albani Zaria transcripts (scripts/albani/normalize.py). The ASR writes the same word split and joined (kan su / kansu, da ke / dake); each entry maps the split spelling onto one token so both count as one word. Matching runs on the folded key, so hooked and unhooked spellings are both covered. Add a pair only when both spellings occur and mean the same thing.
